# ContentFellow

> ContentFellow is a UK creative and digital marketing service. Businesses and creators hire "Fellows" (specialists) on simple monthly plans from £59 a month: production, video editing, social media, websites and SEO & GEO for AI search.

- All plans and prices on one page: https://contentfellow.com/pricing/

## Plans (brand pricing, monthly; personal plans 15% lower)
- Studio Fellow (£149/mo): one on-site shoot a month up to 3 hours, photo + 4K video, 20 edited photos in 5 working days
- Creator Fellow (£119/mo): 8 short videos for Reels/TikTok/Shorts, 1 motion graphics video, 1 podcast edit up to 60 min
- Social Fellow (£59/mo Manage: up to 2 platforms, weekday replies, ad set-up; £129/mo Manage + Post: up to 3 platforms, daily posting, trend research)
- Build Fellow (£69/mo): custom website up to 5 pages, hosting, security, updates, 2 change requests a month
- Search Fellow (£89/mo): SEO for Google, GEO so ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini recommend you, monthly ranking + AI visibility report
- Growth Fellow (£389/mo, £555 separately): all five Fellows, a Growth lead, one strategy, one monthly report
